# localmelo

> localmelo is a local personal agent: it runs tasks with tools and memory on a model server you run or on a hosted model.
> The `melo` command runs one task with fixed exit codes and a JSON line, or opens a chat; a gateway on 127.0.0.1 serves a web console and an HTTP API.
> It is pre-alpha: interfaces may change before v0.1.0. Agents start at [localmelo for agents](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/for-agents.md).

## Start

- [localmelo documentation](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/README.md): the index of every documentation page.
- [Quickstart](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/start/quickstart.md): install, run a first task, save a configuration and start the gateway.
- [Overview](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/en/index.html): the website's home page.
- [Quickstart](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/en/quickstart.html): the website's quickstart.

## Guides

- [Set up an embedding model](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/embedding.md): set up the embedding model that gives search by meaning.
- [Gateway and HTTP API](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/gateway.md): start the gateway, keep it private and run it at login on macOS.
- [Guide: API client](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/api-client.md): drive localmelo from a script over its HTTP API.
- [Guide: Terminal](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/terminal.md): chat in the terminal: keys, commands, approvals and workspace.
- [Guide: Sessions](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/sessions.md): keep a conversation between runs and resume it.
- [Guide: Python](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/python.md): run tasks from Python, follow events, stop runs and approve calls.
- [Guide: Tools MCP](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/tools-mcp.md): choose built-in tools, add MCP servers, and the checks and permission tiers.
- [Guide: Offline retrieval](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/offline-retrieval.md): evaluate memory retrievers offline.
- [Guide: Memory](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/memory.md): keep, inspect, reset and turn off memory.
- [Guide: Model servers](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/model-servers.md): run oMLX, Ollama, MLC LLM, vLLM, SGLang or melo_serve and point localmelo at it.
- [Guide: Configure](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/configure.md): set up, change, update or remove localmelo.
- [Guide: Scheduler](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/scheduler.md): how the scheduler shares one model server, and how to simulate it.
- [Guide: Web console](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/web-console.md): use the web console: chats, tasks, Settings and permissions.
- [The macOS app (development build)](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/macos-app.md): build and use the macOS development app.
- [Browsing with melo](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/browsing.md): let melo read and act on web pages in Chrome or Safari.
- [Art pack: replace every picture of Melo](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/art-pack.md): replace every picture of Melo from an art pack.
- [Guide: Hosted models](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/hosted-models.md): use a hosted model service, with the key in the keychain.
- [Searching the web with melo](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/guides/web-search.md): let chats and tasks search the web.

## Reference

- [Command-line reference](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/cli.md): `melo` command words, options, settings, output, exit codes and signals, and use from scripts.
- [Configuration](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/configuration.md): the config file, backends, settings, environment variables and the files localmelo writes.
- [API v2](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/api-v2.md): the web console's HTTP API under `/api`: sessions, turns, tasks, approvals, settings and memory.
- [Sessions](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/sessions.md): conversations kept in SQLite: turns, statuses, message ids, approvals and export.
- [Memory](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/memory.md): what localmelo stores, where, and how to inspect, reset and protect it.
- [Tools and MCP](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/tools.md): the built-in tools, web reading and search, and which tools a step offers.
- [Troubleshooting](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/troubleshooting.md): error messages and how to fix them.
- [Python API](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/python-api.md): `Agent`, `AgentOptions`, `RunResult` and their methods.
- [Events](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/events.md): the events a run reports, their order, fields and guarantees.
- [Run results](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/run-results.md): run statuses, the fields of the JSON line and `RunResult`, and retries.
- [Offline retrieval](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/retrieval.md): `melo-retrieve`, which compares memory retrievers offline.
- [Scheduler: policy core and simulator](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/scheduler.md): tasks, workers, task endings and the scheduler's policy core and simulator.
- [localmelo for agents](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/for-agents.md): the contract for AI agents: commands, exit codes, output, routes, files and rules.
- [Reference: Procedures](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/procedures.md): `melo-procedures`: replay, episodes, export and forget.
- [Reference: Http v1](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/reference/http-v1.md): the gateway's HTTP v1 endpoints.

## Concepts

- [Procedural memory](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/concepts/procedures.md): the steps of recurring tasks, which every run records at its end.
- [How localmelo works](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/concepts/how-it-works.md): the run loop, reflection, memory and time limits.
- [Architecture](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/en/architecture.html): how work flows between chats, the scheduler, workers and approvals, in diagrams.
- [Memory design](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/en/memory-design.html): the maintainer's memory design.
- [Concepts: Retrieval](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/concepts/retrieval.md): how retrievers rank memory and how a run recalls it.
- [Concepts: Memory](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/concepts/memory.md): what localmelo remembers and how a run recalls it.

## Project

- [Evaluations](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/project/evaluations.md): the controlled comparisons behind the defaults.
- [Maintaining the docs](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/project/documentation.md): how the docs and the website are laid out, changed and translated.
- [Roadmap and updates](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/en/updates.html): the roadmap board and what changed, by day.
- [Developers](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/en/developers.html): the repository layout, setup, tests, and how to add a backend, a tool or a check.
- [Documentation style guide](https://localmelo.github.io/localmelo/STYLE.md): how documentation is written.
